meta.orientation: every probability is P(first-named fighter A wins); the model is exactly symmetric (swap A/B -> 1 - p)

experts.market: de-vigged closing moneyline P(A) (power method; MoE.devig); optional
experts.feat_lr: built-in feature LR: MoE.featLR(doc.feat, sideA, sideB, ctx) on fighters.json profiles
experts.ml: tools/ml.py page model P(A) (when this key is listed in model.experts)

gate_inputs.layoffA/layoffB: days since the fighter's previous UFC fight (null -> 365)
gate_inputs.ageA/ageB: age in years at the fight date (null -> 30)
gate_inputs.preufcA/preufcB: true when data/derived/preufc.json has the fighter's pre-UFC record

meta.engine_bt: data/derived/moe_engine_bt.json (engine 3.0.0, params sha c3eec94838d335ab, 100 sims per corner order)
meta.notes: model = production composite refit on 2019-2025 with the hyper-parameters chosen by forward-chained CV inside 2019-2023 (method 'switch': 'present' when a market line is given, else 'absent'); model_validated = the 2019-2023 fit that produced the static 2024-2025 report.

feat.notes: symmetric L2 logistic regression on side-feature differences, no intercept; 'coef' fit on decisive UFC fights 2010-2025, 'coef_valid' on 2010-2023 (produced the static 2024-2025 numbers); priors = division rates from fights 2021-2025

chosen.rule: per regime (market line present / absent) the stacker family + hyper-parameters with the lowest forward-chained CV log loss (validation years 2021-2023, train from 2019); calibration kind chosen nested inside the CV; 2024-2025 never used for a choice
